title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule

translated_title: ScanAR：面向统一自回归模型高效图像生成的并行行扫描解码方法
translated_abstract: 统一多模态自回归（AR）模型将文本和图像表示在同一个 token 序列中，并通过共享的下一 token 预测头生成所有模态。然而，其图像生成过程以光栅顺序逐个解码 H×W 的视觉网格，需要 HW 个串行步骤，主导了推理时间。现有的视觉 AR 生成加速方法要么改变分词器、预测头或模型接口，要么在保留模型的情况下无法在不损失质量的前提下达到高并行度，因此这些方法无法直接迁移到统一 AR 模型中。我们提出 ScanAR，一种行扫描并行解码方法，它仅重新定义视觉 token 的前驱关系。第一行视觉 token 仍按惯例从左到右生成，而后续每一行都在单个并行步骤中生成，其中每个 token 均由上一行垂直对齐的 token 预测得出。非视觉 token 则保持标准的自回归规则。
tldr: ScanAR 通过仅重新定义视觉 token 的前驱关系，实现逐行并行解码，在无需修改模型结构的情况下大幅加速统一多模态自回归模型的图像生成。
en_tdlr: ScanAR accelerates image generation in unified multimodal autoregressive models by redefining only the predecessors of visual tokens, enabling row-wise parallel decoding without modifying the model.
